description: User-facing text for stable runtime and workflow error codes. Clients show the entry for a known code in the UI language and fall back to the server or Connector message only for unknown codes.

agent_acp_unavailable.zh-CN: Agent 的 ACP 入口不可用，请确认它安装完整，并能在本机运行它的 ACP 检查命令。
agent_acp_unavailable.en: The agent's ACP entry point is unavailable. Make sure the agent is fully installed and its ACP check runs on this device.

agent_authentication_required.zh-CN: Agent 需要先在本机完成登录或模型配置。
agent_authentication_required.en: Sign in to the agent or configure its model on this device first.

agent_capability_unsupported.en: The agent does not provide this capability.

agent_cli_missing.zh-CN: 未找到本机的 Agent 命令行。请先安装该 Agent，或在实例配置中填写它的路径。
agent_cli_missing.en: The agent's command-line tool was not found on this device. Install the agent, or set its path in the instance configuration.

agent_cli_unsupported.zh-CN: 无法直接启动该 Agent 的批处理入口，请在实例配置中填写实际可执行文件的路径。
agent_cli_unsupported.en: The agent's batch-file launcher cannot be started directly. Set the path of the actual executable in the instance configuration.

agent_configuration_failed.zh-CN: 配置或提交尚未完成，请先查询原操作。
agent_configuration_failed.en: Configuration or submission has not finished. Check the original operation first.

agent_guarantees_missing.zh-CN: 当前 Agent 不能满足该会话的恢复保证。
agent_guarantees_missing.en: The current agent cannot meet this session's recovery guarantees.

agent_install_failed.zh-CN: Agent 运行环境安装失败，请检查网络后重试。
agent_install_failed.en: Installing the agent runtime failed. Check the network and try again.

agent_open_failed.zh-CN: Agent 初始化未完成，请先查询原操作。
agent_open_failed.en: Agent initialization has not finished. Check the original operation first.

agent_projection_failed.zh-CN: Agent 更新未能可靠保存，需要恢复校准。
agent_projection_failed.en: An agent update could not be saved reliably. The session needs to be recovered.

agent_recovery_required.en: The session's agent needs to be recovered.

agent_resume_unsupported.zh-CN: Agent 未提供会话恢复能力。
agent_resume_unsupported.en: The agent does not support resuming sessions.

agent_session_failed.zh-CN: Agent 无法创建会话，请在本机检查它的模型与认证配置。
agent_session_failed.en: The agent could not create a session. Check its model and sign-in settings on this device.

agent_session_mismatch.zh-CN: 原生会话身份不一致，已停止操作。
agent_session_mismatch.en: The native session identity does not match. The operation was stopped.

agent_session_missing.zh-CN: 原操作尚未确认原生会话身份。
agent_session_missing.en: The original operation has not confirmed the native session yet.

agent_session_unavailable.zh-CN: Agent 无法恢复此会话：原会话可能已不存在，或 Agent 配置已变化。
agent_session_unavailable.en: The agent could not resume this session. The original session may no longer exist, or the agent's configuration changed.

agent_steer_attachments_unsupported.zh-CN: 当前 Agent 运行中追加指令暂不支持附件。
agent_steer_attachments_unsupported.en: This agent does not accept attachments when adding instructions to a running turn.

agent_version_unsupported.zh-CN: 当前 Agent 版本不受支持，请升级后重试。
agent_version_unsupported.en: This agent version is not supported. Upgrade it and try again.

attachment_cache_invalid.zh-CN: 本机附件缓存校验失败。
attachment_cache_invalid.en: The local attachment cache failed verification.

attachment_mismatch.zh-CN: 附件内容与上传记录不一致。
attachment_mismatch.en: The attachment content does not match its upload record.

attachments_too_large.zh-CN: 附件超过上限：每条消息最多 16 个，总大小不超过 32 MiB。
attachments_too_large.en: Attachments exceed the limit: up to 16 per message and 32 MiB in total.

attachments_unsupported.zh-CN: 当前执行者不支持首条附件。
attachments_unsupported.en: The current agent does not support attachments on the first message.

capability_unavailable.zh-CN: 该会话当前不能执行此操作。
capability_unavailable.en: This session cannot perform this action right now.

claude_resume_no_response.zh-CN: Claude 恢复会话后没有回复这条消息。
claude_resume_no_response.en: Claude did not reply to this message after resuming the session.

command_unavailable.zh-CN: 命令目录已变化，请刷新。
command_unavailable.en: The command list has changed. Refresh it.

configuration_changed.en: The configuration option is no longer available.

configuration_conflict.zh-CN: 选择之间不一致，请重新选择模型和推理强度。
configuration_conflict.en: The selections conflict. Choose the model and reasoning effort again.

configuration_mapping_unavailable.zh-CN: 该旧选择没有唯一且无损的 Agent 配置映射。
configuration_mapping_unavailable.en: This earlier selection has no exact agent configuration mapping.

image_input_unsupported.zh-CN: 当前模型声明不支持图片输入，请移除图片或切换支持图片的模型。
image_input_unsupported.en: The current model does not declare image input. Remove the image or switch to a model that supports images.

initialization_interrupted.zh-CN: 初始化执行者已退出，首条消息尚未提交，请重新准备。
initialization_interrupted.en: The initializing agent exited before the first message was submitted. Prepare again.

interaction_capacity.zh-CN: 待回答请求已达到上限。
interaction_capacity.en: Too many requests are waiting for an answer.

interaction_scope_mismatch.en: The answer does not belong to this operation.

interaction_stale.zh-CN: 交互所属执行者或版本已变化。
interaction_stale.en: The interaction's agent or version has changed.

invalid_agent_configuration.zh-CN: Agent 配置身份无效或重复。
invalid_agent_configuration.en: The agent configuration identity is invalid or duplicated.

invalid_agent_executable.zh-CN: Agent 需要已安装的绝对入口路径。
invalid_agent_executable.en: The agent needs an absolute path to an installed executable.

invalid_attachment.en: An attachment identity is invalid or duplicated.

invalid_command.zh-CN: 命令与原始输入不一致。
invalid_command.en: The command does not match the original input.

invalid_configuration_value.zh-CN: 配置值不在当前可用范围。
invalid_configuration_value.en: The configuration value is outside the available range.

invalid_cwd.zh-CN: 请选择存在的绝对工作目录。
invalid_cwd.en: Choose an existing absolute working directory.

invalid_form_response.zh-CN: 表单回答不符合请求要求。
invalid_form_response.en: The form answer does not meet the request's requirements.

invalid_form_schema.en: The agent's form structure is invalid.

invalid_runtime_response.zh-CN: Runtime 返回的结果无效，请更新 Connector 后重试。
invalid_runtime_response.en: The runtime returned an invalid result. Update the Connector and try again.

invalid_selection.zh-CN: 模型与推理强度选择无效。
invalid_selection.en: The model and reasoning effort selection is invalid.

message_identity_required.en: The message needs a stable identity.

message_rejected.zh-CN: 当前权限或用户审批未允许此消息。
message_rejected.en: The current permissions or approvals do not allow this message.

native_history_recovery_failed.zh-CN: 恢复失败，请查看原生历史后重试。
native_history_recovery_failed.en: Recovery failed. Review the native history and try again.

native_history_recovery_unconfirmed.zh-CN: 恢复结果尚未确认，请先查询原操作。
native_history_recovery_unconfirmed.en: The recovery outcome is unconfirmed. Check the existing operation first.

native_history_release_unconfirmed.zh-CN: 未能确认已释放执行，请刷新后再试。
native_history_release_unconfirmed.en: Releasing execution could not be confirmed. Refresh and try again.

node_abi_unsupported.zh-CN: 自动安装的 Linux Node 运行环境需要 glibc。
node_abi_unsupported.en: The automatically installed Linux Node runtime requires glibc.

node_archive_invalid.en: The Node package contains an invalid path.

node_archive_too_large.zh-CN: Node 下载超过大小上限。
node_archive_too_large.en: The Node download exceeds the size limit.

node_checksum_mismatch.zh-CN: Node 下载校验失败，请重试。
node_checksum_mismatch.en: The Node download failed verification. Try again.

node_checksum_missing.zh-CN: Node 发布包缺少校验记录。
node_checksum_missing.en: The Node release has no checksum record.

node_install_invalid.zh-CN: Node 运行环境校验失败。

node_platform_unsupported.zh-CN: 此设备平台暂不支持自动准备 Node。
node_platform_unsupported.en: Automatic Node setup is not supported on this device platform.

not_pending.zh-CN: 该创建已明确拒绝，没有待回答请求。
not_pending.en: This creation was rejected and has no pending request.

operation_input_conflict.zh-CN: 相同操作身份不能用于不同输入。
operation_input_conflict.en: The same operation identity cannot be used for different input.

operation_not_found.en: The operation or session does not exist.

operation_outcome_unknown.zh-CN: 结果尚不确定，请先查询原操作，不要重复提交。
operation_outcome_unknown.en: The outcome is uncertain. Check the original operation instead of submitting again.

outcome_unknown.zh-CN: 结果尚不确定，请先查询原操作，不要重复提交。
outcome_unknown.en: The outcome is uncertain. Check the original operation instead of submitting again.

owner_changed.zh-CN: 会话执行者已变化，请刷新。
owner_changed.en: The session's agent has changed. Refresh and try again.

permission_denied.zh-CN: 当前权限或用户审批未允许此命令。
permission_denied.en: The current permissions or approvals do not allow this command.

plan_review_expired.zh-CN: 这次计划审阅已失效，请刷新会话后重新确认。
plan_review_expired.en: This plan review has expired. Refresh the session before confirming again.

planning_unavailable.zh-CN: 当前会话无法进入或继续规划。请检查所选 Agent 和连接状态。
planning_unavailable.en: Planning is unavailable for this session. Check the selected agent and its connection.

pi_adapter_cache_corrupt.zh-CN: Pi ACP 缓存依赖来源已变化。
pi_adapter_cache_corrupt.en: The cached Pi ACP dependencies have changed.

pi_adapter_dependencies_missing.zh-CN: Pi ACP 依赖目录不存在。
pi_adapter_dependencies_missing.en: The Pi ACP dependency directory is missing.

pi_adapter_incompatible.zh-CN: Pi ACP 适配器版本不受支持，需要 0.1.x。
pi_adapter_incompatible.en: The Pi ACP adapter version is not supported; 0.1.x is required.

pi_adapter_integrity_failed.zh-CN: Pi ACP 发布包摘要不匹配，未应用兼容补丁。
pi_adapter_integrity_failed.en: The Pi ACP package digest does not match, so the compatibility patch was not applied.

pi_adapter_patch_failed.zh-CN: Pi ACP 适配器的兼容入口已变化，暂不支持此版本。
pi_adapter_patch_failed.en: The Pi ACP adapter's compatibility entry points changed, so this version is not supported yet.

pi_authentication_required.zh-CN: Pi 没有可用的模型或认证：本机模式请先运行 pi 完成登录或模型配置，受管环境请检查模型网关。
pi_authentication_required.en: Pi has no usable model or credentials. In local mode, run pi to sign in or configure a model first; in the managed environment, check the model gateway.

pi_cli_exit_required.zh-CN: 请先退出 CLI 中对应会话，并确认后继续。
pi_cli_exit_required.en: Exit the session in the CLI first, then confirm to continue.

pi_cli_missing.zh-CN: 未找到本机 pi，请指定 CLI 路径或明确选择受管环境。
pi_cli_missing.en: No local pi was found. Specify the CLI path or choose the managed environment.

pi_continue_required.zh-CN: 这是本机原生会话，退出 CLI 后点击「继续任务」即可在 AA 中继续。
pi_continue_required.en: This is a local native session. Exit the CLI, then choose Continue to resume it in AA.

pi_dependency_resolution_failed.zh-CN: 无法校验本机 Pi 的完整依赖来源。
pi_dependency_resolution_failed.en: Could not verify the full dependency source of the local Pi.

pi_environment_failed.zh-CN: Pi 执行环境准备失败，请检查安装与网络。
pi_environment_failed.en: Preparing the Pi environment failed. Check the installation and network.

pi_execution_source_changed.zh-CN: 此 Pi 实例的运行模式或配置目录已变化；请恢复原配置，或新建 Pi 实例。
pi_execution_source_changed.en: The run mode or configuration directory of this Pi instance changed. Restore the previous setting or create a new Pi instance.

pi_history_incomplete.zh-CN: 原生历史正在写入或存在损坏记录，请重新校准。
pi_history_incomplete.en: The native history is still being written or has damaged records. Recheck it.

pi_history_invalid.zh-CN: 文件没有有效的 Pi 原生会话头。
pi_history_invalid.en: The file has no valid Pi session header.

pi_history_migration_required.zh-CN: 此历史需要格式迁移，当前仅开放浏览，未修改源文件。
pi_history_migration_required.en: This history needs a format migration. It is browse-only for now and the source file is unchanged.

pi_history_outside_source.zh-CN: 历史位置已超出配置的来源目录。
pi_history_outside_source.en: The history location is outside the configured source directory.

pi_history_too_large.zh-CN: 历史文件超过单文件读取上限。
pi_history_too_large.en: The history file exceeds the per-file read limit.

pi_history_unreadable.zh-CN: 原生历史文件无法读取。
pi_history_unreadable.en: The native history file cannot be read.

pi_installation_ambiguous.zh-CN: 发现多个本机 Pi 安装，请在 CLI 路径中指定要使用的一个。
pi_installation_ambiguous.en: Several local Pi installations were found. Specify the one to use in the CLI path.

pi_installation_unsupported.zh-CN: 无法将此 pi 入口绑定到兼容 SDK；请指定 npm 安装的真实 pi 入口。
pi_installation_unsupported.en: This pi entry cannot be bound to a compatible SDK. Specify the real pi entry installed with npm.

pi_model_unavailable.zh-CN: 原会话模型不可用，请先恢复对应原生模型配置。
pi_model_unavailable.en: The original session's model is unavailable. Restore its native model configuration first.

pi_models_required.zh-CN: 请在自定义模型中至少添加一个模型。
pi_models_required.en: Add at least one model under custom models.

pi_models_unavailable.zh-CN: 无法获取模型列表，请在自定义模型中填写模型 ID 后重试。
pi_models_unavailable.en: Could not load the model list. Enter a model ID under custom models and try again.

pi_node_incompatible.zh-CN: 本机 Pi 需要可用的 Node 22.19 或更高版本。
pi_node_incompatible.en: The local Pi needs Node 22.19 or later.

pi_permissions_failed.zh-CN: Pi 审批守卫异常，执行已停止。
pi_permissions_failed.en: The Pi approval guard failed. Execution was stopped.

pi_permissions_unavailable.zh-CN: Pi 工具审批扩展未能加载，已阻止执行。
pi_permissions_unavailable.en: The Pi tool approval extension failed to load. Execution was blocked.

pi_recovery_interrupted.zh-CN: Connector 重启中断了恢复，请查看最新历史并重新确认继续。
pi_recovery_interrupted.en: A Connector restart interrupted the recovery. Review the latest history and confirm again to continue.

pi_resume_failed.zh-CN: Pi 恢复失败，请检查原生模型、认证与扩展兼容性。
pi_resume_failed.en: Resuming Pi failed. Check the native model, authentication and extension compatibility.

pi_sdk_incompatible.zh-CN: 此 Pi 版本不受支持：需要 1.2.0 及之后的 1.x npm 安装，且能加载 AA 需要的 SDK 接口；不会使用其他 SDK 替代。
pi_sdk_incompatible.en: This Pi version is not supported. A Pi 1.x npm installation from 1.2.0 on whose SDK provides the interfaces AA needs is required; no other SDK is used instead.

pi_session_already_running.zh-CN: 此会话已在 AA 执行。
pi_session_already_running.en: This session is already running in AA.

pi_source_ambiguous.zh-CN: 多个历史文件具有相同会话身份，请先确认来源。
pi_source_ambiguous.en: Several history files share the same session identity. Confirm the source first.

pi_source_busy.zh-CN: 另一 AA 执行实例正在使用此原生会话。
pi_source_busy.en: Another AA instance is using this native session.

pi_source_changed.zh-CN: 原生历史已变化，请查看最新内容后重新继续。
pi_source_changed.en: The native history has changed. Review the latest content and continue again.

pi_source_conflict.zh-CN: 原生历史已被外部修改，已停止 AA 执行；请退出并发 CLI 后重新校准。
pi_source_conflict.en: The native history was modified elsewhere, so AA stopped. Exit the concurrent CLI and recheck.

pi_source_identity_changed.zh-CN: 原生历史身份或位置已变化，旧历史仍保留，但不能继续原绑定。
pi_source_identity_changed.en: The native history identity or location changed. The old history is kept but cannot continue its binding.

pi_source_mismatch.zh-CN: 恢复返回的原生历史位置不匹配，已停止执行。
pi_source_mismatch.en: The recovered native history location does not match. Execution was stopped.

pi_source_missing.zh-CN: 原生历史来源暂时不可用，已保留浏览内容。
pi_source_missing.en: The native history source is temporarily unavailable. The browsed content is kept.

pi_source_unreadable.zh-CN: 原生历史来源当前无法读取，已保留浏览内容。
pi_source_unreadable.en: The native history source cannot be read right now. The browsed content is kept.

pi_workspace_missing.zh-CN: 原会话的项目工作目录不存在或无效。
pi_workspace_missing.en: The original session's working directory is missing or invalid.

pi_writer_unavailable.zh-CN: 原生历史写入校验尚未就绪。
pi_writer_unavailable.en: Native history write verification is not ready yet.

preparation_consumed.zh-CN: 工作区准备已绑定其他创建操作。
preparation_consumed.en: The workspace preparation is already bound to another creation.

preparation_not_reserved.zh-CN: 工作区准备尚未为当前创建操作预留。
preparation_not_reserved.en: The workspace preparation has not been reserved for this creation.

preparation_stale.zh-CN: 工作区准备已失效，请重新准备。
preparation_stale.en: The workspace preparation is no longer valid. Prepare again.

project_workspace_mismatch.en: The project does not belong to the selected device.

recovery_required.zh-CN: 会话需要恢复后才能继续。
recovery_required.en: The session needs to be recovered before it can continue.

response_input_conflict.zh-CN: 回答身份已用于其他内容。
response_input_conflict.en: The answer identity was already used for other content.

run_capacity.en: Too many runs are in progress.

session_not_ready.zh-CN: 会话尚未空闲或需要恢复。
session_not_ready.en: The session is not idle yet or needs to be recovered.

sync_backpressure.zh-CN: 同步积压已达到上限，请恢复连接。
sync_backpressure.en: Too much sync work is pending. Restore the connection.

takeover_required.zh-CN: 请先授权工作台控制此会话。
takeover_required.en: Allow the workbench to control this session first.

unsupported_acp_version.zh-CN: 该入口只启用了 ACP v1。
unsupported_acp_version.en: This executable only supports ACP v1.

unsupported_operation.en: The agent does not provide this operation yet.

worker_capacity.zh-CN: Agent 执行进程已达到上限。
worker_capacity.en: Too many agent processes are running.

workflow_unsupported.zh-CN: 该 Runtime 不支持工作区准备。
workflow_unsupported.en: This runtime does not support workspace preparation.
